answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow stops bulk fake identities. A new identity deposits $40 into escrow, then builds a behavior thread over 12 epochs, fingerprinted on task timing and counterparty mix. A matching thread unlocks the nectar of rewards; a comet identity that flashes and vanishes builds no thread, so its escrow burns. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x $40 = $40,000 in vain, while one honest agent pays $40 once and earns $12 per epoch.
